Final for Publication

22930-T1
SUBSTITUTE NARRATIVE AND PLANS
TYPE I Rezoning
1143-55 North Wells Street
From C1-5 to DX-5

The Property

The property is improved with a 3-story mixed used building with ground floor commercial, 28 upper floor residential
units, and 25 automobile parking spaces. The property is a Transit Served Location per the Transit-Oriented
Provisions of the Chicago Zoning Ordinance (Section 17-10-0102-B(1)) because it fronts the Division Street Bus
Line Corridor Roadway Segment, and it is within 330 feet of the Clark and Division Red Line CTA Station Entrance.

The Project
The Applicant seeks to rezone the property to allow the use of a portion of the building’s ground floor commercial

space totaling 2,555 sq. ft. as an Adult Use Cannabis Dispensary (the “Dispensary”). The balance of the building will
continue to be used for unrelated residential and commercial uses. No exterior modifications to the building are
proposed other than the removal of the existing canopy/awning on the exterior of the proposed Dispensary space,
erection of a sign band along the frontage of the Dispensary space and removal of the door enclosure at the
Division/Wells door of the proposed Dispensary. No on-site automobile parking spaces will be provided for the
proposed Dispensary. The height of the building is and will remain at 36 ft. To achieve the proposed project the
Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a C1-5 Neighborhood Commercial District toa DX-5 Downtown Mixed-
Use District.

The following are the relevant zoning parameters for the proposed project:

Lot Area: 14,964 square feet

Floor Area: 52,374 square feet (existing)

FAR: 3.5 (existing)

Residential Dwelling Units: 28 (existing)

MLA Density: $31.32

Height (existing): 36 feet (existing)

Bicycle Parking: None Required

Automobile Parking: 25 (existing)

Loading Berth: None (existing)

Setbacks: Front (Wells): 0° (existing)
North Side (Division): 0” (existing)
South Side: 0° (existing)
Rear (Alley): 0° (existing)

Distance to nearest School: Greater than 190 feet

A set of plans is attached of the proposed Adult Use Cannabis Dispensary space.
